import networkx as nx

def check_graph(edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(range(12))
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    
    # Check max clique size
    clique_size = nx.graph_clique_number(G)
    
    # Check chromatic number
    chromatic_number = nx.coloring.greedy_color(G)
    num_colors = max(chromatic_number.values()) + 1
    
    # Check min degree
    min_degree = min(dict(G.degree()).values())
    
    return clique_size, num_colors, min_degree
